verdict.rationale: Flagright is API-first: its REST API with JSON request and response bodies can be driven entirely headlessly. It also ships official Python and Node/TypeScript clients, OpenAPI specs, and dedicated sandbox servers suitable for automated test runs. The Management API supports programmatic rule-instance creation with idempotent updates, plus case and alert operations, enabling config-as-code automation. Missing for 10: a dedicated CLI, documented CI/CD integration guidance (e.g., pipeline examples), and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless/CI use.
